description: Class (FWZZ) entry screen. One id field plus four action buttons - Create/Display/Change/Delete. No product type field here; that is asked for inside the Create dialog (see fwzz-create-dialog.json).

idNumber.title: Security Class ID Number
idNumber.note: Left blank for an internally-numbered product type (26B: SAP refuses a typed id with 'Numbers assigned to product type 26B internally - do not enter an ID number'). Not every product type on this screen is internally numbered - discover before assuming.

createButton.note: Opens the Create Class dialog (fwzz-create-dialog.json). Does not commit.
